name: HERO
rules: Can use equipment marked as HERO only
Can make a Heroic Reaction once per battle
Can make a characteristics increase or select a trait when gaining renown
Can be sent to find items at the Trading Post
Must roll on the Hero Injury Table when taken out of action

name: LEADER
rules: Friendly fighters within 6" can use the Leader's Bravery characteristic when taking Panic tests
If killed, a new leader must be selected

name: HENCHMAN
rules: Can make a characteristics increase when gaining renown
Becomes a HERO when reaching 4 renown
Must roll on the Henchman Injury Table when taken out of action

name: WIZARD
rules: Can use magical abilities
Can make the Channel Magic action
Cannot be equipped with armour

name: BEAST
rules: Never gain experience or renown
Cannot make scenario actions
Cannot be given equipment, but uses natural weapons

name: THRALL
rules: Bound to the VAMPIRE leading the warband
Cannot be equipped with any weapons, armour or equipment
Never earn experience or gain renown
Cannot carry treasure tokens
Automatically pass any Bravery test they are required to take

name: MUTANT
rules: Must make a Stability test when gaining renown, before making a characteristics increase or selecting a talent

name: TERRIFYING
rules: A fighter making an attack action against a TERRIFYING enemy must take a Bravery test or become Panicked. On a passed test, that fighter ignores further Bravery tests caused by TERRIFYING enemies for the remainder of their activation.
